title: Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar
paragraphs: A detective drama about freelance insurance investigator Johnny Dollar, whose expense-account narration carries him through fraud, theft, missing persons, and murder cases across several distinct starring eras.

CBS detective drama centered on freelance insurance investigator Johnny Dollar. GRH also preserves pre-series/role audition material, including Dick Powell (1948), John Lund daily-serial audition material (1952), and Gerald Mohr (1955).

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Charles Russell era (February 11, 1949 to January 14, 1950) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], Edmond O'Brien era (February 3, 1950 to September 3, 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], John Lund era (November 28, 1952 to September 19, 1954) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and Bob Bailey five-part serial era (October 3, 1955 to November 2, 1956) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|bob-bailey|Bob Bailey]] (performer), Jack Johnstone (director, producer, and writer), [[person|virginia-gregg|Virginia Gregg]] (performer), Roy Rowan (announcer and performer), Amerigo Moreno (music supervisor, music, and violin), Lawrence Dobkin (performer), and Forrest Lewis (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]], and [[org|org.11b14cc584c53bc7|WROW]].
The stories often return to Murder, Insurance claims, Theft and robbery, Maritime transport, Suicide, and Medical emergencies.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes network radio drama during the rise of television and CBS package-program strategy.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|escape|Escape]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]], and [[show|philip-marlowe|The Adventures of Philip Marlowe]].
